maria.g: Quick ask — where's the canonical list that maps KV/prefix cache panels -> dashboards/panel IDs and alert owners? I need to point a PM to the right panel and to who owns the alert.

sam.t: Hi — it's in the Grafana space but a bit scattered. Start with this: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcdef/prefix-cache-overview?orgId=1
It has the overall hit-rate and per-model panels. Panel IDs are in the top-right menu "View panel" -> "Share".

maria.g: thanks. Is there a shorter link directly to the hit-rate panel? PM wants to embed it in a doc.

sam.t: Use this one for the overall prefix hit-rate: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcdef/prefix-cache-overview?panelId=7
And per-tenant hit-rate is panelId=12. If you need the raw query it's:
```
sum by (tenant) (cache_hits_total{cache="prefix_kv"}) / sum by (tenant) (cache_requests_total{cache="prefix_kv"})
```

alex.k: Owners: infra-cache owns the panel + alert, see runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/kv-cache
If alert noise is the issue, bump eval window to 5m and reduce sensitivity: change alert expr to use `increase(...)` over 5m and set threshold to 0.7.

maria.g: Perfect. Any guidance for alert tuning without masking real regressions? PM worried about missing real drops.

jordan.p: Suggestion: add a second alert rule that fires only for <10% absolute drop sustained over 15m and target weighted-by-traffic tenants. That reduces noisy small fluctuations.
Example alert (Grafana alert expression):
```
(hit_rate < 0.75) and (hit_rate - hit_rate[15m] < -0.10)
```

cache-oncall-bot: NOTE: there is an existing alert `KV Prefix Cache Hitrate (critical)` -> owner: @infra-cache. Alert id=kc-1034. See /alerts page.

maria.g: Awesome, I'll link those to the ticket. @sam.t @alex.k if you can add the specific panel links to the runbook that'd be great. :thumbsup:

sam.t: on it, will PR the runbook tonight.

alex.k: Can add a short section on tuning heuristics. Ping me in the PR for review.

maria.g: thanks all, closing this thread once PR merged.
